### NAME

`anthropic-python` - Anthropic Python SDK.

### SYNOPSIS & usage

*Derived from the upstream README at generation
time; verify against `--help` where the tool is
installed.*

```
pip install anthropic
```

### DESCRIPTION (upstream)

The Claude SDK for Python provides access to the [Claude API](https://docs.anthropic.com/en/api/) from Python applications. Tool helpers (`@beta_tool`, the tool runner and `ToolError`) are documented in [tools.md](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/tree/HEAD/tools.md). The browser and computer toolset classes have their own guides, [browser-toolset.md](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/tree/HEAD/browser-toolset.md) and [computer-toolset.md](https://github.com/anthropics/anthropic-sdk-python/tree/HEAD/computer-toolset.md). Full documentation is available at **[platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/sdks/python](https://platform.claude.com/docs/en/api/sdks/python)**.
